institution: Kerala Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance Network (KARS-NET), Department of Health Services, Kerala
citation: Kerala Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance Network (KARS-Net). Annual Report (Reporting period 01/01/2021 to 31/12/2021). Thiruvananthapuram: Department of Microbiology, Government Medical College, Thiruvananthapuram (state nodal centre), Kerala Antimicrobial Resistance Strategic Action Plan (KARSAP); 2022.
reporting: Percent resistant by pathogen and specimen (blood; pus aspirate and other sterile body fluids together; urine), all location types pooled, with number tested and number resistant; overall (all specimens) charts with numbers resistant and tested; location-type (IN, OUT, ICU) charts with printed data labels, for all specimens together (E. coli, Klebsiella, Pseudomonas, Acinetobacter) or for blood with PA+OSBF and for urine (Enterococcus); MRSA and VRE trend chart.
method: WHONET collation and analysis; conventional or automated identification; AST by disc diffusion, broth microdilution or automated systems; first isolate per patient, specimen type and pathogen (21,765 isolates reported, 14,353 unique-patient isolates). Vancomycin results for S. aureus and colistin results for Gram-negative bacilli were not included because testing methods were not uniform. No rule against percentages from fewer than 30 isolates is stated.

verification.note: Tables 6, 7, 8, 9, 11 and 12 parsed from the PDF text layer (pdfplumber words assigned to columns by x position; the column order differs between tables and was checked on each page) and every value compared by eye with the pages rendered at scale 2.2; every printed percentage recomputed from its printed counts (no disagreement). The overall charts (Figures 10, 13, 15, 17, 19) were read from the text layer and checked on the rendered pages; each number resistant and tested equals the sum of its specimen table and each percentage its counts. Location charts (Figures 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20): data labels from the text layer, each matched to its bar by a script comparing the bar colour on the page rendered at scale 4 with the legend marker colours, labels without a bar (0) placed by their position in the group, then every label checked by eye on the rendered chart; the text statements for Pseudomonas imipenem, Klebsiella ICU and Acinetobacter imipenem and ICU values match. MRSA and VRE trend labels read from the rendered chart. Count Tables 3 and 5 checked against the images and their printed totals. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages.

notes: First Kerala state antibiogram (KARS-Net annual report for 2021; the report is undated, its PDF was created in November 2022): 18 laboratories in 9 districts, seven priority pathogens. All figures are percent resistant (intermediate counted as not resistant). In 2021 pus aspirate and other sterile body fluids were reported together (PA+OSBF, shown under deep infections). The specimen tables pool all location types (set all); the location charts pool all specimens (recorded as all specimens by location) except for Enterococcus, charted for blood with PA+OSBF (recorded as all specimens except urine) and for urine; the overall charts give all specimens and locations (recorded as all specimens, all settings) and the all-specimen S. aureus (cefoxitin) and Enterococcus (vancomycin) rows carry the MRSA and VRE trends. Location type was unknown for 877 isolates. The report prints percentages even for fewer than 30 isolates tested; those cells keep their number tested and a note.
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: every cell re-read blind against the page images before comparing (all 394 cells, including the seeded sample of 98, plus all 41 row n and all 40 counts; tables at scale 2.5, charts zoomed at scale 4): 0 transcription errors, nothing corrected.

Second reader: all 171 location-chart cells (Figures 11, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20) also checked by a script against each figure's own legend marker colours (IN grey, OUT orange, ICU blue, except Figure 14: OUT grey, IN orange, ICU blue) and the colour of the bar behind each data label: drug, location and value agree for every cell. Every figure of the overall charts (Figures 10, 13, 15, 17, 19) equals the sum of its specimen table columns.
Second reader: the two hidden cells are printed: Table 9 gives nitrofurantoin for Klebsiella from PA+OSBF (63 tested, 51 resistant, 81%) and from blood (19 tested, 8 resistant, 42%).

Second reader: count differences confirmed as printed. Figure 7 (page 19) gives 877 isolates (6%) with unknown location and Table 5 totals 13,476 (14,353 less 877); the shortfalls of the Table 5 location counts against the Table 3 organism totals add up to exactly 877, which is why the six overall rows exceed the location sums. The chart legend N differ from Table 5 as printed: E. coli OUT 2943 against 2944, IN 2112 against 2116; Klebsiella ICU 473 against 476.

Second reader: data year confirmed as 2021. The cover prints the reporting period 01/01/2021 to 31/12/2021, and pages 8, 9 and 12 say the data run from 1 January to 31 December 2021 (18 sites, 9 districts). The report prints no publication date; published 2022 rests on the PDF creation date (7 November 2022).
Second reader: every printed percentage of Tables 6 to 12 recomputed from its printed counts; no disagreement.

Second reader: added as counts (all specimens, all settings) the isolate totals per organism printed in the Total column of Table 3, page 17 (sum 14,353); the overall rows now check exactly against them.

Lead 2026-09-26: "pus aspirate" (reported together with other sterile body fluids in 2021) filed under specimen "deep" (deep infections, aspirates), as for the other NCDC-protocol networks; 6 rows and 6 counts moved from "pus". The "Blood + PA+OSBF" column (every specimen except urine and stool) is filed as "all specimens except urine" (1 row).
